A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GLVQ research and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–I. The complete material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 and the appendices report original GLVQ perplexity, zero-shot accuracy, inference throughput, and ablation results on Llama models.

after.justification: The same original GLVQ experiments and outcomes remain reported in Section 4 and the appendix tables.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain identical bit allocation, group-specific lattice learning, Babai rounding, companding, optimization objectives, and decoding procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use RedPajama calibration data, WikiText-2 and C4, and ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy, PIQA, and Winogrande evaluation. The revised RedPajama reference does not indicate a dataset or task change.

E2.justification: Tables 1–4 retain identical comparator membership within each experiment. For example, Table 3 still includes BiLLM, OneBit, PV-Tuning, and PB-LLM. Bibliographic substitutions introduce no evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Model configurations, bit budgets, lattice dimensions, metrics, calibration sizes, and testing procedures are unchanged. Both retain the main 2048/4096-token context settings, 4M-token calibration, and batch-one RTX 4090 throughput evaluation.

E4.justification: Section 4.5 and Appendices D–I retain the same analyses of bit allocation, lattice adaptation, companding, group size, calibration size, and Babai rounding versus greedy coordinate descent. Appendix B's storage analysis is also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point-estimate reporting without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–13 and their associated findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports GLVQ-32D WikiText-2 perplexity of 3.36 for 2-bit Llama-2-70B in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations are unchanged, including Appendix A's Babai-rounding error-bound derivation and Appendix B's storage formulas. Updating the Babai reference does not alter the proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about adaptive grouped lattices, companding, and low-bit accuracy–efficiency trade-offs.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability qualifications are unchanged. Section 5 retains the fixed-partition and weights-only limitations, and Appendix C retains the same broader-impact discussion.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, calibration instructions, and the GLVQ repository link are unchanged. The CUDA reference gains a generic homepage URL while retaining version 10.2.89; this is bibliographic elaboration without changed experimental instructions.

R1.justification: Limited citation substitutions occur: the introduction replaces Banner et al.'s quantization reference with Liu et al.'s Post-training quantization for vision transformer, and Section 2.3 replaces Haykin's communications text with Bhagyaveni et al.'s. The research-positioning narrative remains unchanged; most other reference edits update metadata.

P1.justification: Citation numbers, bibliographic author and publication details, and the version/date stamp are revised. The main prose, section order, explanations, and appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Revised references reflow across pages 11–14, with limited citation-induced line-wrap changes elsewhere. Figure 1, Algorithm 1, and Tables 1–13 retain their displays and placement.

improvement.justification: V2 modestly improves bibliographic completeness and source traceability, adding the WikiText source's arXiv identifier and publication details for works such as PV-Tuning and QTIP. These are limited documentation gains; the method, empirical evidence, theoretical analysis, and limitations are unchanged.
